requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport class has an issue with the disconnect method not properly closing the stdin stream when it's still open. This leads to assertion errors in context manager tests where 'close' is expected to be called but isn't.
requirement.contract: When disconnect() is called, it must properly close the stdin stream if it's open, ensuring that the transport can be cleanly terminated. The method should ensure that all streams (stdout, stderr, stdin) are closed and cleaned up properly.

requirement.description: The receive_messages method in SubprocessCLITransport is not correctly handling AsyncIterator protocols for streaming mode. Tests are failing with "TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine" because the method doesn't properly implement the async iterator protocol.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method must return an AsyncIterator that properly implements the async iteration protocol. When used in async for loops, it should yield messages correctly without requiring explicit __aiter__ calls.

requirement.description: The _stream_to_stdin method in SubprocessCLITransport is not properly managing the stdin stream lifecycle, particularly when dealing with async iterables. This causes the stdin stream to remain open or improperly closed in certain scenarios.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method must properly manage the stdin stream lifecycle, ensuring it's closed appropriately when the streaming is complete or interrupted, and that it handles exceptions gracefully without leaving streams in inconsistent states.
